integrity: Proof uses exact edge-crossing classification and the spherical direction transform; Monte Carlo tests and numerical quadrature corroborate but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only central uniformly oriented planes through a right prism over a fixed centrally symmetric polygon with at least six genuine base vertices; height inversion assumes the known base including scale. Independent mathematical validation and complete historical priority checks are not available.
title: Central-section stratification and height rigidity for symmetric polygonal prisms
